categories.main_business_segments: SRE Holdings operates two main business segments: (1) AI Cloud & Consulting (AICC), which provides AI-driven cloud tools and DX solutions for healthcare, IT, finance, and real estate sectors; and (2) Life & Property Solutions (L&P), which includes asset management, brokerage consulting, and development of smart properties such as IoT-enabled residential and commercial facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies, including machine learning and proprietary AI modules, to develop predictive analytics engines, cloud-based workflow automation, and DX solutions. It emphasizes in-house product development, integration of real-world business feedback, and partnerships for joint solution development. IoT and ESG technologies are also applied in property development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include healthcare institutions, financial service providers, IT companies, and real estate businesses. The company serves both B2B clients seeking digital transformation and operational efficiency, as well as investors and end-users in the real estate market.
categories.geographic_coverage: SRE Holdings primarily operates in Japan, with the vast majority of revenue generated domestically. It has some international collaboration, notably with Sony India Software Centre for software development, but overseas sales and assets are not material.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both as a technology provider (upstream/midstream, supplying SaaS and AI solutions to businesses) and as a downstream player in real estate, engaging directly in asset management, property development, and sales to investors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding stock-based (recurring) revenue through SaaS, accelerating product development in healthcare and real estate tech, and leveraging real-world business operations to refine AI solutions. The company invests in R&D for AI, cloud, and IoT, and actively pursues M&A to broaden its technology and domain reach. There is a strong focus on sustainability, talent development, and the integration of generative AI.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of recurring SaaS/cloud service subscriptions, consulting fees, and one-time sales from real estate transactions and asset management. The AICC segment emphasizes stock (recurring) revenue, while L&P includes both recurring management fees and transactional income from property sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Competitors include major SaaS and AI solution providers in Japan, as well as large real estate portals and traditional real estate firms. SRE differentiates itself as a 'life-tech' company that combines real-world business operations with proprietary technology, positioning itself as a unique tech provider with deep domain expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue was approximately 26.7 billion yen, with operating profit of 3.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 1.7 billion yen. The company has demonstrated strong growth, with revenue increasing by over 10% year-on-year and significant expansion in both SaaS and asset management businesses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SRE Holdings emphasizes its unique position as a 'tech provider embedded in real business,' offering AI solutions validated and refined through its own operations in healthcare, finance, IT, and real estate. Its value proposition centers on practical, high-utility AI/DX tools, domain-specific expertise, and the ability to deliver both technology and operational improvements, resulting in high customer retention and competitive differentiation.
